description: This file defines the InBinary class, a binary expression node for Twig's templating engine, representing the 'in' operator for expression compilation.

classes.name: InBinary
classes.description: A class that represents the 'in' binary operation node within Twig's expression AST, handling the compilation role of converting the 'in' operator into PHP code.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the 'in' binary expression into PHP code by invoking CoreExtension::inFilter with the left and right operands.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string 'in' as the operator identifier for this binary node.
